## #2 — tg_jp — 2012-01-08
<https://www.cheetah3d.com/forum/index.php?threads/8005/post-66385>

hello

it works for just mesh data, but material option is not work same as another my importer scripts; script api to access material data is missing.

some mqo file encoded with 'Shift-JIS' character encodings may cause error, so you have to change file encoding to 'UTF-8' from 'Shift-JIS' with editor application before importing. some file will not be imported correctly, if you have some problem, please let me know it.  

regards.

tg_jp, Hiroto.
